content: The root project uses local AppSDK 0.1.6 and Guidance enforcement is advisory. appsdk verify . passes at contract_bound; project-memory currently has the stable index and no project-scope durable entries before this write-back. Root child contracts and lifecycle truth remain outside the root memory projection.
title: AppSDK Guidance state

content: The root registry marks agent-tui and Teams active with child-owned AppSDK contracts/maps, marks dsh-concurrency-limit active with a pending local binding, and marks agent-memory pending with no owned source path. Missing agent-memory source must not be represented as an active implementation path.
title: Child project registry

content: AgentHost and AgentRemote are the downstream TUI protocol boundary. TuiSessionService consumes their session, command, workspace, event, and interaction surfaces; app-container is explicitly forbidden from directly depending on transport or agent adapters.
title: AgentHost and AgentRemote seam

content: After the adaptor seam, the current TUI normalizes session history/events, projects semantic presentation, interprets text and tool cards, resolves theme, maintains display-buffer state, renders terminal frames, and drives the terminal lifecycle. These layers are declared in agent-tui contracts and are not provider-specific protocol owners.
title: TUI downstream rendering chain

content: OpenCodeServeClient is the only concrete agent adaptor currently constructed by agent-tui startup. The transport contract names OpenCode serve as the current client base; the current source has no ACP implementation, adaptor registry, or second concrete agent adaptor.
title: Current concrete adaptor

content: The OpenCode adaptor explicitly returns unsupported errors for operations it does not implement. The current path does not silently downgrade or fallback, and downstream code must not interpret an unsupported control operation as a successful agent action.
title: Unsupported operation policy

content: agent-tui AppSDK function-map.json and mainline-call-map.json currently bind generic AppSDK lifecycle chains but do not fully bind the source-level TUI transport, session, presentation, render, lifecycle, or adaptor edges. The finer-grained ownership exists in agent-tui/contracts/tui; the AppSDK map binding is therefore incomplete and must not be reported as a complete runtime map.
title: TUI map binding gap
